headline: Fighting Surges Across Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line
war_summary: Callahan's Passage has seen Warden forces consolidate control over all ten strategic positions following fresh engagements at Crumbling Post, where over sixteen hundred casualties fell during the last two hours alone. Fighting has also erupted fiercely along the Nevish Line, marked by sharp spikes in butcher bills and rapid enlistments on both sides. In Stlican Shelf, clashes persist around Port of Rime and Breaker Town, leaving Colonial troops in possession of seven bases while one remains destroyed in no-man's-land. Weathered Expanse continues to record heavy, accelerating casualties despite a temporary pause in direct base turnovers over the past two hours, with two strongpoints lingering in neutral ruin. Meanwhile, earlier flashpoints in Palantine Berm and Stonecradle have cooled into relative quiet after enduring dozens of structural exchanges throughout the preceding day.
